verdict.rationale: Segment's Public API is documented with an OpenAPI spec, an interactive reference, SDKs, auth tokens, rate limits, pagination and versioning. It explicitly supports CRUD on Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans, so an agent could programmatically create sources and destinations. However, nothing in the evidence shows explicit connection wiring between sources and destinations, inspecting event deliveries, or an official MCP server. missing for 10: documented delivery inspection (event delivery/observability via API), explicit source-to-destination connection wiring, an official MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server

citations.quote: You can use the API to perform CRUD (create, read, update, and delete) operations at no extra charge. This includes working with resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans
